notes.text: Uncovered ink y 5431-5522 is the last body line («ходилъ.» Говоритъ: «Ну-ка, пойдемъ!... А»), directly above the footnote rule; the text layer has no row for it. It belongs with band 2 (Continued), whose y1 stops just above it.
Line 1 is an empty row beside the running title (no ink); harmless, sits between band 1 and band 2.
